charts.aggregation: daily end-of-day balance from Deals (not fabricated)

method.avgMonthlyNetProfit: Arithmetic mean of monthly trading net P/L (deposits/withdrawals excluded).
method.avgMonthlyReturnPct: Arithmetic mean of (month net P/L / month starting equity) × 100, starting equity = prior end balance.
method.avgMonthlyMaxEquityDd: Arithmetic mean of each month's peak-to-trough drawdown on end-of-day balance within that month (floating equity unavailable in Deals).
method.avgMonthlyMaxEquityDdPct: Arithmetic mean of each month's peak-to-trough drawdown % vs intra-month peak.

trades.note: Returning the most recent 2500 closed deals (direction=out).
